relationships.evidence: Proposed, not enacted. FY2026 Budget Appendix p.360: 'In 2026 SAMHSA will be reorganized into the Agency for a Healthy America to improve coordination of health resources for Americans.' FY2027 Appendix p.464 repeats it for 2027. P.L. 119-75 keeps SAMHSA.
